name: io.github.EduardiP/phronexusai
title: PhronexusAI
description: Find complementary businesses for cross-promotion, check ad results and install your ad space.

tools.name: find_complementary_partners
tools.description: Analyzes a public business website and returns its business category, whether it sells to businesses or consumers, and the two business categories whose customers are most likely to need it without competing with it. Use when the user wants to know which kinds of businesses could cross-promote with a given website. Input: the website address.

website.description: Business website address, for example example.com or https://example.com

tools.name: get_account_overview
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user's PhronexusAI account: business name and website, plan, which distribution pools (Auction, Balance) the account uses, today's used and remaining daily participations, and the status of each setup step (business, description, ad space, ad, conversion tracking).

tools.name: get_ad_performance
tools.description: Returns statistics for the signed-in user's business over a period: impressions, real views (seen at least 1 second), clicks and conversions of the user's ads on partner websites, and of partner ads on the user's website, with daily totals for charts.

tools.name: list_my_ads
tools.description: Lists the signed-in user's ads with their text, status (active or paused), pool, creation date and impressions and clicks in the last 30 days.

tools.name: list_partner_categories
tools.description: Returns the business categories of the partner websites where the signed-in user's ads were shown, and of the partners whose ads were shown on the user's website, with impressions and clicks per category.

tools.name: get_ad_space_code
tools.description: Returns the HTML code of the signed-in user's ad spaces (where partner ads appear) with installation instructions for common website platforms, including the PhronexusAI WordPress plugin.

tools.name: check_ad_space_installation
tools.description: Loads a public page of the signed-in user's website and reports whether the PhronexusAI ad space code is present in its HTML. Does not change anything. Code added only by JavaScript may not be detected.

page_url.description: Page to check; defaults to the account's website
